name: Old Border Cube
description:
# OLD BORDER CUBE

Welcome to the **Old Border Cube**, where you can recreate some of the top decks of the [Premodern](https://premodernmagic.com/) era and enjoy the beauty of the classic borders! Play 1995-2003 classics such as ErhnamGeddon, [[Psychatog]], [[Replenish]], [[Fires of Yavimaya]], Necro, Sligh, The Rock, [[Opposition]] and more, all while fawning over the gorgeous old border cards!

This is based on the Old Border Foil Cube, but since I don't adhere to foils, I added earlier nostalgic cards that fit the era and power level. Cards need to have an old border printing early cards should be such that they were reprinted and legal around 1995 (4th Edition/Ice Age/Chronicles). 
  
# **AESTHETICS**

Most of this 360-card cube comes from the Beta, early expansion sets, Ice Age, Mirage, Urza's, Masques, Invasion, Odyssey and Onslaught blocks. Also, due to the quite limited card pool, the cube embraces Wizards' revival of the retro frame by running set of cards from Time Spiral, Time Spiral: Remastered, Modern Horizons 2, The Brothers' War Retro Artifacts, Dominaria Remastered and various promotional series. But the cube tries to maintain the Premodern feel, nostalgia and power level with the inclusion of any newer printed cards that were given the old border treatment.

# **DESIGN**

The cube's primary archetypes are:

{W}{U} – Draw-Go Control, [[Replenish]] / Enchantment Combo, UW Fliers, UWx Stax / Prison
{W}{B} – Midrange, Aggro-Disruption
{W}{G} – “ErhnamGeddon” WG Midrange + [[Armageddon]]
{W}{G}{U} – Enchantress, [[Oath of Druids]], [[Mirari's Wake]] Control
{W}{R} – RW Control, Goblins Splash

{U}{G} – Tempo / Madness, [[Opposition]] Ramp-Tempo
{U}{B} – Control, Reanimator
{U}{R} – Counter-Burn, UR Spells / Tempo

{B}{G} – The Rock, Graveyard Value / [[Recurring Nightmare]]
{B}{R} – Midrange, Sacrifice / Aristocrats
{R}{G} – [[Fires of Yavimaya]] Aggro / Midrange

{B}x – [[Necropotence]] / Black Devotion
{R}x – Goblins, Sligh, Big Red Cheat ([[Sneak Attack]])
{U}x – [[High Tide]] Storm, Big Blue Combo ([[Upheaval]], [[Time Spiral]])

[[Wildfire]] – UR, RG, or 3–5c Ramp / Control
3–5c – Control, Ramp, Goodstuff Midrange
